paint.wood: Close-up photograph taken straight on, perfectly flat with no perspective, of an old table top of warm dark oak planks lying side by side, their grain running across, a few knots, even warm light, no shadow, filling the whole image.
paint.view: Photograph of a wide bright blue sky full of soft white cumulus clouds, and only at the very bottom of the picture a thin strip of calm blue sea along a low horizon, nothing on it, no land, no ship.
paint.brass: Close-up photograph, straight on and perfectly flat, of a plain sheet of old brushed brass, warm gold, fine straight brushing lines running across, slightly worn, even light, no reflection, no curve, no ridge, filling the whole image.
paint.parchment: Close-up photograph, straight on and flat, of smooth old cream parchment, faintly mottled, no folds, no creases, no lines, even light, filling the whole image, no writing.
